text.title: Our nostro ledger against the correspondent bank's statement
text.lede: Not every open item deserves the same attention. Each one is placed by how long it has been open and how much it is worth. The shaded corner, old and large, is where to start. New and small items along the bottom left usually clear by themselves.
text.chartTitle: Open items by age and amount
text.chartSub: USD account at 31 March 2026. Amounts on a compressed scale. The lines mark 30 days and 100,000.
text.clearZone: New and small: likely to clear
